    if (!file.exists() || !file.isFile()) throw new IOException("File does not exist: " + file);
    List<ThreadSnapshot> result = new ArrayList<>();
    try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file))) {
        String line;
        while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
            line = line.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            ThreadSnapshot ts;
            try {
                ts = ThreadSnapshot.parse(line);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                // skip invalid lines
                continue;
            }
            long tsTime = ts.getCreateTimestamp();
            boolean ok = true;
            if (timeRanges != null && !timeRanges.isEmpty()) {
                ok = false;
                for (ProfileAnalyzeTimeRange r : timeRanges) {
                    if (r == null) continue;
                    if (tsTime >= r.getBegin() && tsTime <= r.getEnd()) {
                        ok = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (ok) result.add(ts);
        }
    }
    return result;
